notes.title: Small Fixes And tweaks
notes.content:
Now you can select audio language and text language separately.
Now you can change the character view FOV.
In case you get dizzy with the head tilt, now you can turn it off.
A small fix to pick between WASD / ZQSD /<AOE
Spare part giver bug fixed
Air vents grid pieces no longer prevent you from jumping
Fixed some holes in the ground.
